recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rename structureType back to type for this issue; that would reverse later WG-approved ExampleScenario cleanup. Revisit only if the work group reopens ExampleScenario naming more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-19951 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested renaming ExampleScenario.instance.resourceType because it collided with the JSON serialization pseudo-element resourceType. The resolution said to rename it to type.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in b8667da649 and merged as 0dc020eab51b01c95a4a6a810f77f2bc0961a6c0, changing ExampleScenario.instance.resourceType to ExampleScenario.instance.type in the StructureDefinition and example XML.
additional_context: ExampleScenario remains an active current-build resource. Later Published issues in the same artifact family matter: FHIR-37195 also listed instance.resourceType -> instance.type, FHIR-22855 broadened the element to describe FHIR or non-FHIR structures with Coding/extensible binding, and FHIR-37895 explicitly changed instance.type to instance.structureType to align with structureVersion and structureProfile[x]. The remaining fhir.ini resourceType occurrence is only an r4-r6-changes migration map to structureType.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current StructureDefinition and examples use ExampleScenario.instance.structureType, and a current-source search found no ExampleScenario resourceType element.
